data.name: SCP: Minor Case -FLP-
data.detailed_description:
Notice

This work is a fan creation based on the SCP Foundation and the works published on the SCP Wiki.

This work is released under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 License (CC BY-SA 3.0), consistent with the licensing of the SCP Wiki.

Please refer to the online manual for the SCPs featured in this work.

All characters, organizations, and settings appearing in this work are fictional and are not related to any real individuals or organizations.

This work does not intend to endorse or support any real individual or their actions, nor does it intend to disregard or diminish the experiences of those who may have been affected by related events.

The creator is a fan of SCP and is not affiliated with the official staff. The views and expressions presented in this work do not represent official positions.

If policies or guidelines within the SCP community change in the future, the creator may review this work and consider appropriate adjustments in response.

As a fan creation, it would be an honor if you could enjoy this work as part of the SCP universe.


About the Game

My ██ is still mine alone.

SCP: Minor Case -FLP- is a story-driven adventure game set within the facilities of the SCP Foundation.

You are neither a D-class personnel nor an elite agent, but a Level 0 staff member untouched by dangerous research.

That doesn't mean you won't get caught up in containment breaches, though.

You'll face things far more unjust than death.

  • Exploring Foundation Facilities

    Players explore the Foundation’s facilities,

    advancing the story while responding to and evacuating from containment breaches.

  • Branching Scenarios Based on Actions

    The scenario changes depending on your actions and choices.

    Whether you gain or lose trust is entirely up to you.

  • Encounters with Notorious SCPs
    You won't just be attacked; you can also cooperate with SCPs.
    Of course, it won't end well.

  • Interactions with Distinctive Doctors
    Beyond SCPs, you'll have varied exchanges with the doctors.
    Whether they're friend or foe depends on the player.

  • Casual 2.5D Style

    This game features a laid-back art style that combines pixel art characters with low-poly 3D models,
    so horror elements and gory depictions are kept to a minimum. Probably.

This isn't an event that will shake the world.

For the Foundation, it's a trivial - Minor Case.
